column4: Visit note | 2026-04-12 03:30 PM | Dr. Shahadat Hossain, ENT | Patient: Monir Haque, 64, male. Mr. Haque reports troublesome pressure over his cheeks and forehead along with a blocked nose. His symptoms started after a cold during a rainy week in Rampura. He works as a tailor and has a history of Hypothyroidism for which he takes thyroxine. He denies any dental pain, vision changes, or neck stiffness. On examination, his temperature is 100.7°F, BP is 124/78 mmHg, pulse is 104 bpm, and weight is 97 kg. Nasal mucosa appears congested with tenderness over the maxillary sinuses. Assessment: Acute sinusitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use steam inhalation twice daily and drink plenty of warm fluids. Follow-up in 10 days.

Visit note | 2026-04-12 04:30 PM | Dr. Rezaul Karim, Neurology | Patient: Ziaur Ahmed, 66, male. Mr. Ahmed complains of dizziness when looking up, brief spinning sensations when turning in bed, and associated nausea with the spinning. These symptoms began after bumping his head on a rickshaw hood in Narayanganj. He works as a homemaker and has no significant comorbidities. He reports no hearing loss, tinnitus, or double vision. On examination, the Dix-Hallpike test positive on the left side, with other vitals showing BP 116/74 mmHg, pulse 84 bpm, and weight 52 kg. Assessment: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to get up slowly from bed, avoid sudden head movements, and repeat the Epley manoeuvre at home as shown. Follow-up in 2 weeks.
